== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Onwan, Lord of the Ntouka]] ([[Arkjok Ward]])

== Notes ==
* The 3-second recharge listed is in addition to any recharge the skill affected may already have had.
* [[Hero]]es won't use this skill on their own.

==Trivia==
*The warrior in the [[skill icon]] appears to be wearing [[Warrior Sunspear armor|Sunspear Armor]].
*None of the Ntouka-named creatures ([[Ntouka Bird]]s, [[Crested Ntouka Bird]]s, and [[Rampaging Ntouka]]s) can use Rage of the Ntouka, but they sometimes hang with [[Steelfang Drake]]s, who can.
